prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical 4:5 artistic editorial portrait of a young woman from the chest up, centered and looking directly at the viewer with a soft relaxed smile. She has dark brown shoulder-length slightly messy layered hair with wispy bangs, warm natural skin, delicate facial features, and round thin black wire-frame eyeglasses. Dress her in exactly 3 visible accessories/clothing elements: 1) an oversized chunky ribbed knitted beanie in heather taupe gray, 2) a loose black long-sleeve ribbed knit sweater with softly bunched sleeves, and 3) a short silver chain necklace. Pose her with shoulders slightly angled, arms forward near the bottom edge, head gently tilted, calm intimate expression. Use dreamy golden-hour backlighting from the upper right, creating a glowing rim light around the hair, beanie, shoulders, and sweater edges, with warm amber highlights and soft shadows on the face. Render as a hybrid of realistic photography and painterly editorial illustration: crisp facial detail, natural eyes and lips, visible knit texture, subtle skin texture, and expressive charcoal-like sketch strokes around the silhouette. Background is a textured gray plaster wall with abstract scratched graphite marks and warm gold paint smears, especially on the right side, blending into the subject edges. Add loose black hand-drawn contour scribbles around the hat, hair, sleeves, and shoulders for an art-magazine mixed-media look. Shallow depth of field, soft cinematic contrast, high detail, warm muted palette, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张高度精细的 4:5 竖版艺术编辑风格人像，拍摄 一位年轻女性 的胸部以上特写，人物居中，直视镜头，面带柔和放松的微笑。她拥有 深棕色齐肩微乱层次感发型，配有轻薄刘海，温暖的自然肤色，精致的五官，佩戴圆形细黑框眼镜。为她搭配 3 种清晰可见的配饰/服装元素：1) 一顶超大粗棒针织帽，颜色为 石楠灰褐色；2) 一件黑色宽松长袖罗纹针织衫，袖口微微堆叠；3) 一条短款银色链条项链。姿势要求双肩微侧，双臂置于画面底部边缘前方，头部轻微倾斜，表情平静而亲密。使用来自右上方的梦幻黄金时刻背光，在头发、针织帽、肩膀和毛衣边缘形成发光的轮廓光，面部带有温暖的琥珀色高光和柔和阴影。渲染风格融合写实摄影与绘画编辑插画：面部细节清晰，眼睛和嘴唇自然，针织纹理可见，皮肤质感细腻，轮廓周围带有表现力十足的炭笔素描笔触。背景为带有抽象石墨划痕和暖金色颜料涂抹的灰色灰泥墙，尤其在右侧，与主体边缘相融合。在帽子、头发、袖子和肩膀周围添加随意的黑色手绘轮廓涂鸦，营造艺术杂志般的混合媒介视觉效果。浅景深，柔和的电影感对比度，高细节，温暖柔和的色调，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。
